_readme: Additional out-of-scope words / phrases YOUR portal should refuse. These add to the base UNSUPPORTED set in app/extract.py  -  they don't replace it. Use with care: any hit sends the question to Route C (scope refusal). Keys starting with `_` are ignored.

_docs.when-to-add: When a question class is fundamentally unanswerable from your data (`inventory`, `stock levels` if you don't have them; `profit` if you don't have COGS).
_docs.when-not-to-add: Never add common words like `orders` or `revenue`  -  those are the answers, not out-of-scope. This is only for words that mean 'my portal doesn't do this'.
